design_limits: Scenario IDs and byte-level fingerprints do not prove semantic independence. Each purpose needs human review.
This is a newly authored 100-case schema, not the original 20 cases copied with their PASS results.
The semantic assertions are proposed observables for collectors, not additional fields already present in production documents.
The 2030 clock and named sample shops/events are synthetic. No real opening hours are claimed.
